title: Submarine finds world's deepest explosive volcanic activity in Mariana trench | New Scientist
description: A deep-sea robotic submarine has found evidence of explosive volcanic eruptions 6100 metres below sea level, surprising scientists who were only seeking geological samples
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: COP31 collapse has shattered the pretence of a global climate consensus | New Scientist
description: Climate progressive countries took the radical step of torpedoing a deal at the UN summit in Turkey amid outrage over obstructionist tactics from petrostates. What happens now?
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: Ancient human settlements boosted biomass of today’s Amazon rainforest | New Scientist
description: Rainforest with a history of human occupation has 2.8 per cent greater biomass, on average, than untouched regions, and this means we might have slightly overestimated Amazonian biomass by mainly assessing formerly occupied areas
author: Chris Simms

title: Mathematicians are amazed by ‘holy grail’ proof of Riemann hypothesis | New Scientist
description: As news spread that an Anthropic researcher used AI to find an answer to one of the longest-standing questions in their field, mathematicians expressed awe, uncertainty and at least one claim of having a competing proof in the works
author: Karmela Padavic-CallaghanandMatthew Sparkes

title: Quantum effect could reverse gravity and violate Einstein’s theory of relativity | New Scientist
description: Two mathematical investigations devised a way to possibly make gravity produce repulsion between objects, breaking away from a long-standing understanding of this force
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: What is the Riemann hypothesis and why is its solution so monumental? | New Scientist
description: It has been called the hardest problem in mathematics, and now through a combination of human ingenuity and relentlessness, and the computational power of AI, the Riemann hypothesis may have finally been solved
author: Karmela Padavic-CallaghanandMatthew Sparkes
